title: Music City Getaway | Entire Private Basement
description:
Welcome to Nashville! Enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located, newly renovated private space. 8 minutes from the airport, 13 minutes from Broadway, 20 minutes from Franklin, and surrounded by great food. You'll get the entire walk out basement that includes two bedrooms, a large living room with a smart TV, kitchenette, and a full (brand new) bathroom with your own separate entrance leading into the driveway. This is a non-smoking property.

The space
▷ Bedroom 1: Queen Bed 
▷ Bedroom 2: Double Bed
▷ Living Room: Large Couch (can sleep 1), Self Inflating Twin Air Mattress + Smart TV 
▷ Bathroom: Complete with a large tiled shower & a washer/dryer

Amenities You’ll Love:
▷ Centrally located in Nashville. 
▷ SUPER FAST WiFi connection (350/Mbps) and plenty of work space 
▷ Private entrance with self check in & keypad smart locks 
▷ Plenty of parking (street parking available on the residential street)
▷ Keurig & a coffee pot for your morning coffee 
▷ White noise machines and blackout curtains in both rooms
▷ TV with a 4K Roku Streaming Stick that allows you to Airplay/Screencast Netflix, Amazon Prime, Disney Plus, & more from your smart phone or computer
▷ Unlimited hot water (tankless water heater)
▷ JUST renovated in 2023. Brand new shower, toilet, vanity top, sink, windows, freshly painted walls, etc.

Guest access
You'll have private access to the basement with your own private entrance.
